# AGENTS.md — z1engine Agent Operating Rules

> This file regularizes the behavior of **every** AI coding agent (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.) working in this repository. Read it in full before starting any task, and follow the rules without exception.

## 1. Project Snapshot

- **Language / platform**: C++17, Windows x64 only
- **Build**: Premake5 generates VS2026 projects (`z1engine.sln` at repo root)
- **Rendering**: OpenGL (GLAD + GLFW), ImGui, render graph with deferred/forward pipelines
- **ECS**: EnTT; **Scripting**: Python 3.14 via pybind11
- **Output**: `engine/bin/<Config>/` (editor/game/tests), intermediate in `engine/intermediate/`

## 2. Mandatory Session-Start Protocol

1. Read `openspec/kb/index.md`, then the topic pages relevant to your task (`architecture.md`, `build.md`, `coding-style.md`, `contributing.md`, `project-map.md`, `dev-scripts.md`, `testing.md`, and any others the task touches).
2. Read `openspec/config.yaml` for the canonical project context.
3. When implementing a feature or behavior change, follow the OpenSpec change lifecycle (see §6).
4. **Never re-derive knowledge that already exists in `openspec/kb/`.** If a page covers the topic, read it instead of guessing.

## 3. Workflow Rules (Mandatory)

- **Report intent first**: state your plan and the steps you will take before modifying files.
- **Minimal changes**: touch only files required by the task. No unrelated refactoring, no broad cleanups.
- **Use the dev CLI for everything**:
  - Build → `python dev/z1.py compile [--config <Debug|Release|Profile>]`
  - Shaders → `python dev/z1.py validate-shaders`
  - Tests → `python dev/z1.py test [--filter <pattern>]`
  - Smoke → `python dev/z1.py smoke --frames <N>`
  - Full verify → `python dev/z1.py dcv --auto`
  - **NEVER** invoke `devenv.com`, MSBuild, `shader_validator.exe`, or test executables directly; never wrap commands in `cmd //c`.
- **Verify before declaring done**: at minimum `compile` must pass with 0 errors. Run tests/shaders/smoke as applicable to the change; complete changes require `dcv --auto` to pass end-to-end.
- **Parse the `RESULT:` JSON line** printed by dev-scripts to decide pass/fail; never guess from exit-code-only output.
- **Preserve local style**: if the file you edit follows a slightly different local convention, match that file's style.

## 4. Coding Style (Summary)

Full rules: `openspec/kb/coding-style.md` and `openspec/specs/agent-code-regulations/spec.md`.

| Rule | Convention |
|------|-----------|
| Indentation | Hard tabs (width 4), never spaces |
| Braces | K&R — `if (cond) {`, `void foo() {` |
| Line endings | CRLF (Windows) |
| Column limit | 120 (soft) |
| Header guards | `#pragma once` |
| Types / functions | PascalCase types (`RenderGraph`), camelCase functions (`on_update`) |
| Members | `m_` prefix (`m_window`) |
| Files | lowercase + underscores; tests `test_<name>.cpp` in `engine/test/` |
| Namespace | `z1` (or nested, e.g. `z1::bakery`) |
| Const | East-const: `Type const&`; pass `std::shared_ptr<T> const&` |
| Ownership | `std::shared_ptr` shared / `std::unique_ptr` unique; raw pointers non-owning only |
| Includes | `pch.h` first in `.cpp`, then own header, same-module, other-module, 3rdparty, stdlib — groups separated by blank line |
| Logging | `CORE_DEBUG` / `CORE_WARN` / `CORE_ERROR` / `CLIENT_INFO`; add `PROFILE_FUNCTION()` on hot paths |
| Comments | Line comments ≤ 1 line; module/class comments ≤ 3 lines; multi-line comments only for whole-system or concept explanations |

**Prohibited patterns**: `using namespace std;`, `std::endl`, `std::cout`/`std::cerr` for diagnostics, raw owning `new`/`delete`, `#ifndef` guards, and **editing `engine/3rdparty/`** without explicit authorization.

## 5. New Files Must Integrate With the Build

- New `.cpp`/`.h` under `engine/` must be covered by the premake5 globs; if not, update `premake5.lua`.
- After adding/removing source files, regenerate projects: `python dev/z1.py generate`.
- New tests in `engine/test/test_<name>.cpp` are auto-discovered by `create_test()` in `premake5.lua`.

## 6. Change Workflow (OpenSpec)

- Follow the spec-driven lifecycle for features and behavior changes: `proposal.md` → `design.md` → `specs/<capability>/spec.md` → `tasks.md`, then implement in order with validation gates between task groups.
- Use the provided skills (`.github/skills/`): `openspec-propose` (create change), `openspec-apply-change` (implement tasks), `openspec-archive-change` (finalize) — plus `openspec-explore` for investigation.
- On completion and passing verification, archive the change under `openspec/changes/archive/`.

## 7. Commit Conventions

- Format: Conventional Commits — `<type>: <description>` with types `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `test`, `chore`.
- AI-generated commits are prefixed `[AI]` and must carry trailers:
  ```
  [AI] feat: add bloom pass

  Generated-by: Copilot
  Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
  ```
- Fully AI-generated files carry a header: `// [AI-GENERATED] This file was generated by an AI agent.` (C++) or `<!-- [AI-GENERATED] -->` (Markdown).

## 8. Pre-Commit Checklist (execute mechanically, report results)

- [ ] Hard tabs; no leading-space indentation in modified lines
- [ ] K&R braces; `pch.h` first include; `#pragma once` in headers
- [ ] PascalCase types, camelCase functions, `m_` members, east-const `Type const&`
- [ ] No prohibited patterns introduced
- [ ] No edits to `engine/3rdparty/`
- [ ] `python dev/z1.py compile` passed (0 errors) — `dcv --auto` for complete changes
- [ ] KB update step completed (see §9)

## 9. Knowledge Base Maintenance

- Consult `openspec/kb/` at session start; at session end, update or extend it when the task surfaced new, non-trivial project knowledge (architecture decisions, non-obvious relationships, surprising findings).
- Update `openspec/kb/index.md` when adding topic pages.

## 10. Dev-Scripts Quick Reference

```cmd
python dev/z1.py generate            # regenerate VS projects via premake5
python dev/z1.py compile             # build solution (--config Debug|Release|Profile)
python dev/z1.py format              # enforce tabs/whitespace/CRLF (--dry-run to preview)
python dev/z1.py validate-shaders    # validate all GLSL shaders
python dev/z1.py test                # run test_*.exe (--filter <pattern>)
python dev/z1.py smoke --frames 10   # launch editor, render N frames, exit cleanly
python dev/z1.py benchmark --suite <name>   # performance regression check
python dev/z1.py dcv --auto          # full develop-compile-verify loop
python dev/z1.py gen-pybinds         # regenerate Python bindings from reflected types
python dev/z1.py release             # package release folder
```

Exit codes: `0` success, `1` build error, `2` validation error, `3` runtime error, `4` configuration error.
